title: the-one-inference-door-carries-a-tool-using-conversation
intention: inference_domain learns to carry a TOOL-USING CONVERSATION — a toolset, an assistant turn whose content is empty because its tool_calls are the content, and a tool-result turn — all the way through the canonical key to the host and back. This is CONTENT of an inference request, not a wire format: the door keeps exactly ONE inbound contract (the bus verb), and the OpenAI/OpenRouter envelope an agent harness speaks is somebody else's job.
why: Law 6 (the sole path to the inference host — a third-party agent configured to dial a provider directly IS a second door, and the only way to close it is to offer a door it already knows how to speak to); Law 3 (metering is complete only because there is no uninstrumented path — a harness outside the door is inference this system cannot measure); Telos 1 (demonstrate inference compilation — a second heavy consumer is the first real test of the yield); Law 7 (the trail records what the call did).
how: Three changes inside inference_domain, composing domain.resolve() and adding no listener, no port and no second connection. (1) host.ollama_resolver's chat branch carries a `tools` key into the /api/chat payload — measured absent, grep -c tools host.py returns 0. (2) host.validated_messages (host.py:184) GROWS A SECOND CHECKABLE SHAPE for agent turns rather than exempting them — the 2026-09-11 gate-health ruling: 'the answer is a second checkable shape, never an exemption'. (3) the zero-horizon lane for agent retries, which needs NO change to domain.py: _valid() at domain.py:252 already treats a past horizon as expired and domain.py:413 stores whatever horizon the resolver returns, so an agent resolver returning a past horizon gets a fresh sample through the charter's own clause (2) rather than around clause (1).
falsifier: DONE when (a) domain.resolve() carries a request with a `tools` list and agent-shaped turns (an assistant turn with empty content and present tool_calls, and a tool-result turn) to hex.local and back; (b) the toolset participates in the canonical digest, so the same turns under a different toolset are a different question; (c) the SECOND turn of a tool-using conversation succeeds under the proof (the one-shot green is the hollow one — the inbound argument-shape failure appears only on turn two); (d) every call lands both a row in inference_calls and an emission line in ~/.cairn/logs/inference_domain/0/, matched by canonical digest; and (e) a byte-identical retry inside an agent loop returns a FRESH sample rather than the stored one. WRONG INTENT if serving an agent turn requires EXEMPTING it from the turn-shape gate rather than growing a second checkable shape (that breaches the gate-health ruling and means the gate is in the wrong place), or if agent traffic has to be exempted from metering to be usable at all — an exemption there would mean the door cannot serve the consumer it was built for.
traces_to: Law 6 (the sole path to the inference host — a third-party agent configured to dial a provider directly IS a second door, and the only way to close it is to offer a door it already knows how to speak to); Law 3 (metering is complete only because there is no uninstrumented path — a harness outside the door is inference this system cannot measure); Telos 1 (demonstrate inference compilation — a second heavy consumer is the first real test of the yield); Law 7 (the trail records what the call did).

watchme.trigger: every inference_calls row whose canonical text carries a `tools` list — that is, every call that asked the door to carry a toolset. CAST AS 'the OpenAI-shaped door' and RESTATED 2026-09-11 at the build, because Akien's mid-voyage rescope (see `rescoped`) moved the OpenAI envelope out of this device entirely and into cairn/machines/openai_wire, held by hermes_shim. The door this probe watches is the one that survived the rescope: the bus verb carrying a toolset. A trigger naming a door that no longer lands here would never fire.
watchme.enough: when 50 toolset-carrying calls have landed AND none of them was served from cache — at that point the byte-identical-retry rate is measured rather than assumed, and the zero-horizon lane is either earning its keep or demonstrably unnecessary. The number is the ticket's, and cairn/devices/inference_domain/probes/an_agent_retry_gets_a_fresh_sample.py reads it as _ENOUGH = 50; it first carried 20 and was raised to match this spec at the build rather than the spec lowered to match it.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier clause (c): a byte-identical retry returns a FRESH sample, not the stored one
watchme.nexus: the inference_domain meter — the same store the yield report reads, so the watch costs no new table
watchme.consumer: CC, and Akien through the operator inbox if the rate says the lane was the wrong shape

proved.what_the_voyage_settled: The one inference door now carries a tool-using conversation end to end: a `tools` list, an assistant turn whose content is empty because its tool_calls ARE the content, and a tool-result turn. Three seams were touched — host.ollama_resolver's chat branch carries `tools` onto /api/chat; canonicalize() digests the toolset so a differing toolset is a DIFFERENT question rather than a cache hit; and the agent shapes are CHECKED, not exempted.
proved.the_last_red_and_it_was_the_door_itself: Clause (a) says THE ONE DOOR, and for every device but this one the one door is the BUS VERB, not the Python call. `_handle_resolve` built its request from a key whitelist that did not contain `tools`, so a caller posting a tool-using conversation over the bus got a coherent TOOLLESS answer and no error anywhere — the exact collapse Law 7 forbids a door to make. Found because a coverage lack forced the honest question (does this proof declare anything?) instead of the cheap one (can I unname it?). Fixed in one key; toothed by test_a_toolset_survives_the_bus_verb, which redded by name before it went green. hermes_shim (cb97524c0e8e) is the first caller through that verb — this red was one ticket away from being someone else's mystery.
proved.the_falsifier_grew_teeth_of_its_own: Its five DONE-when clauses were prose, so proof_coverage.clauses() fell back to [WHOLE] and one tooth would have satisfied a five-clause falsifier. Marking them (a)-(e) TIGHTENED the gate on this voyage's own work, and immediately exposed clause (d) — one call, two records, joined by the canonical digest — as having no tooth in the agent lane. Written, green, and non-vacuous (the digest is asserted to differ from the toolless one).
proved.measured_and_carried_forward_not_fixed_h: qwen3-coder:30b — the only model the shipped stack declares for chat — emits tool calls as TEXT on hex.local ollama 0.30.11, while qwen2.5:7b, llama3.2:3b and devstral-small-2:24b return them structured. prompt_eval_count 291 proves the toolset REACHED the model, so this door did its job; the model choice belongs to cb97524c0e8e.
proved.sealed: test_resolve_verb (8 teeth), test_host (38), test_inference_domain (20), test_the_agent_retry_probe_judges — all green under the tester in netns, 0 red, hollow reading sealed on 4 of 4 standing validations.
